method: Isolated archive of Material with the two grid CSS sources taken from the grid PR and built. Only the normal example boot config is opted into each Material scheme. The actual radio selects Cell & Column & Row; the example selects its initial cell and the pointer moves to another row/column. Browser-computed backgrounds cross-checked against unscaled PNG. Not an integrated or shipped build.
